textBlocks: Sample deliverables, ROI benchmarks, and process walkthroughs — everything you need to evaluate subscription recruiting before you commit.
Model your annual hiring spend against TaaSFlow's subscription pricing. Compare against agency placement fees using SHRM and Ashby 2025 benchmarks.
See exactly what a scored, ranked candidate shortlist looks like — with evidence trails, fit narratives, and recruiter guidance.
The end-to-end process, from intake call to first ranked shortlist in 7–14 days.
Answers to the most common questions about pricing, delivery, and how subscription sourcing differs from agencies.

These playbooks are built for hiring leaders and founders who are tired of paying 20–30% placement fees for opaque agency work. Each one maps to a concrete decision — modeling recruiting spend, previewing what a real TaaSFlow shortlist looks like, understanding the sourcing and screening workflow, or answering common questions before you start a pilot.

Founders, heads of talent, and hiring managers running 3–25 open roles who need faster time-to-shortlist without losing pipeline visibility. If you've experienced ghosted retainers, slow shortlists, or per-hire fees you can't justify, start with the ROI calculator, then walk through how a $399 pilot delivers a ranked shortlist for one live role in 7–14 days.

Every candidate you review comes with a fit score, evidence-backed strengths and gaps, and reviewer notes visible in your live client dashboard — not a PDF dropped in your inbox. Subscription pricing replaces placement fees, so hiring five roles costs the same as hiring one, and your team keeps full control of interviews, offers, and onboarding.
A global hiring system for teams that need consistent recruiting.
Weekly insights into talent acquisition. No spam.
No recruitment agency fees. No placement charges. Subscription-based hiring system.
